title: Michael Smith — Digital Interactions
features: 2700ms loading counter with rotating words and progress, floating pill navigation, cycling roles, original cosmic hero artwork, four-project bento with case-study dialogs, four readable journal entries, pinned two-column exploration parallax/lightbox, exact three stats and animated contact marquee.
limitations: React/TypeScript/Tailwind/GSAP/Framer Motion/hls.js are adapted to native HTML/CSS/JavaScript with no build or runtime dependencies. Original local cosmic/portfolio SVG artwork replaces HLS streams and unspecified third-party images. Reduced-motion mode skips the loader and continuous decoration. Resume, journal and case studies are labeled local demonstration content; business claims and availability originate in the brief, not verification. Email uses the requested mailto address; no backend.
